name: comparison-stand
purpose: Two product listing cards on a shared inspection stand for AI product comparisons
pointer: Choose either listing by its fixed rest centre; it lifts while the other leans away with a distance-based delay.
reducedMotion: Complete server-rendered rest SVG; the shared wrapper does not mount pointer interaction under reduced motion.
validation: hairline-create look.mjs passes frame, read-out, console, and stable motion across all eight poses; 240 px rest and response inspected.
assetRole: Decorative illustration of listing comparison; it does not encode a metric, selection outcome, or growth claim.
